overview_description.description: Locent is a digital health service focused on improving clinical document transmission for healthcare providers. Through Locent's core clinical document management service, providers improve clinical operations, ensure compliance, and simplify data exchange internally and externally. By distributing and tracking clinical documents automatically and on-demand, Locent saves time and lowers the administrative burden on clinicians and their assistants.
